_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Vharlen's own shop data, laid over data/provinces/shops.json key by key (js/sim/province-files.js): only `towns` is Vharlen's — every trader KIND (what a smith, a tailor, an inn sells) is the home file's. `towns.<settlement>` = `zone` (sheet zone), `levelCap` (no stock above it: the band top + 1 to + 2, so the island's shelves run to level 21), `priceMult` (everything is shipped in: 1.1 at the harbour rising to 1.3 at the crater), `note`, and `shops` — WRITTEN by tools/content-offices.mjs --province=vharlen from the trader roles of stream T's town plans. `harbour` = the ships.json harbour this town's pier serves (stream V's Harbourmaster stands there, role `harbourmaster`).

Port Vharl.note: the landing and the island's one real market: every trader, and the Harbourmaster on the pier (stream V, data/provinces/ships.json) sells passage back to the mainland

Mistfall.note: a jungle hamlet round a hot spring: the spring-house is the inn

Yellowpan.note: the sulphur diggers' village: a smith who works with gloves on

Stiltreach.note: houses on stilts over hot mud

Lastwell.note: the fort-town at the last good well before the ash

Cinderholt.note: half a village above the ash, half below it

Kilnhold.note: the fort of the kiln-hands on the basalt steps

Rim Shrine.note: the Rim-keepers' shrine on the crater's edge: a healer, a supplier, little else
